title: Red light moving through the closed church at Dionysiou
summary: Ralph tells of Red light moving through the closed church at Dionysiou, about 1991 at Greece (the ancient oracle sites), and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: I realized I saw a light in the church.

plain: A man named Ralph, talking with podcast host Jesse Michels, says that around 1991 he stayed at Dionysiou, a monastery on Mount Athos, a mountain in Greece that is home to Orthodox Christian monks. He says he saw a red light moving inside the monastery church while it was closed, and he mentions a monk or guide named Timotheus, who gave him books about Athos. He tells it because, if true, something strange was moving through a holy place with no one inside.
